facts.fact: Biometric Update reports National Treasury is leading a year-long pilot of the MzansiXchange data exchange platform, built on Estonia's X-Road technology, with a nationwide rollout to be considered afterwards; date is the article's published date.

Global Government Forum reports South Africa has launched a one-year MzansiXchange pilot led by National Treasury, to be tested in real-world conditions ahead of a broader national rollout; date is the article's published date.

Daily Maverick reports a Presidency Digital Services Unit official presenting a data exchange, described as X-Road, as the second DPI component being implemented, hosted by SITA, within a three-phase roll-out over 24 months.

systems.owner: Digital Services Unit, Presidency; hosted by SITA

facts.fact: The MyMzansi roadmap page refers to a data exchange pilot and sets a milestone to implement a data exchange platform for grant eligibility testing by Q4 2026 and to roll it out to at least 20 more databases by Q4 2027; date is a proxy published date.
National Treasury's media advisory announces the MzansiXchange pilot launch on 9 October 2025, with 11 named partner institutions; date is the advisory's published date.

note: Names partner institutions for the pilot, not a count of connected systems, so no reach fact.

facts.fact: SAnews reports National Treasury launched a one-year MzansiXchange pilot in Pretoria on 9 October 2025, with a prototype built on X-Road to broker data sharing between departments.

National Treasury's pilot page sets out a one-year programme from October 2025 to September 2026 to build the data exchange platform and test it with use cases at SASSA, NSFAS, Home Affairs, the Treasury Secure Data Facility, the Office of the Accountant General, the Office of the Chief Procurement Officer, SEAD-SA and Statistics South Africa; the date is the page's published date.

note: The captured text, read to its end, does not mention MzansiXchange or any data exchange platform; only the metadata mentions it.

facts.fact: The Q3 2025/26 Operation Vulindlela report says the MzansiXchange pilot entered implementation after its 9 October 2025 launch, with pilot infrastructure operational at the CSIR and testing under way between SASSA, NSFAS, DPSA and Home Affairs (four bodies); date is the published date, a proxy for the Q3 2025 report.

note: Only a health-sector exchange is stated; no government-wide platform.

facts.fact: ITWeb reports that the MzansiXchange government data exchange is largely in its piloting phase, to enable cross-government beneficiary verification through integration with the National Population Register and SARS, per the 2026 AENE.

SARS said its National Single Window phased rollout lets SARS share electronically generated inspection cases with the BMA agriculture function, which returns outcomes through a secure interface, with selected plant product importers in phased testing.
SAnews, citing Operation Vulindlela's 2026 Q2 progress report, says the MzansiXchange data-sharing pilot is progressing towards completion in December 2026.

UNDP says it has supported South Africa's National Treasury in designing and piloting MzansiXchange, a national data exchange for data sharing across government, and the pilot is testing the technical model and governance arrangements.

note: A planned exchange platform is already held in evidence.csv; the link is a 2020-2025 strategic plan.

systems.owner: Government Information Technology Officer's Council (GITOC) and SITA
